finalText:
**Redis died at 02:14:07 and never came back. That took prod down 18 minutes later.**

| Time | Event |
|---|---|
| 02:14:07 | `redis connection lost: ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379` |
| 02:14:10 | Cache miss storm, first 5s store timeouts |
| 02:29:12 | Queue depth 502 passes max 500 |
| 02:31:44 | `worker-2` heap out of memory, exit 134 |
| 02:31:52 | `FATAL [supervisor] api unresponsive` service down |

All 13 reconnect tries failed on the same refused port. Redis was down the whole time, not flapping. Totals: 173 timeouts, 174 miss storms, 0 recovery.

Next: check why `10.0.0.12:6379` refused connections. The app has no backpressure, so a cache loss becomes a full outage.
